overview: Set in contemporary Kashmir, star-crossed lovers Qais and Laila struggle against their feuding families, leading Qais down a spiral of passionate madness and eternal love.

title: Scoop
overview: The shocking murder of a prominent crime journalist plunges a leading female crime reporter into a ruthless nexus of the Mumbai underworld, police politics, and the justice system.
tagline: In pursuit of the headline, she became the story.
creator: Hansal Mehta

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.
tagline: The world forever changes.

title: Dream Girl
overview: A young man with a unique talent for impersonating a female voice gets a job at a romantic call center as 'Pooja', leading to chaotic, hilarious romantic entanglements across the town.
tagline: Call karo, dil se dil milao!

title: Don
overview: When the dreaded crime boss Don is killed in a police encounter, DSP D'Silva secretly recruits a look-alike street performer named Vijay to impersonate him and infiltrate the ruthless syndicate.
tagline: Don ko pakadna mushkil hi nahi, namumkin hai!

title: Guru
overview: A relentless villager from Gujarat rises from humble beginnings to create India's largest business conglomerate, fighting corporate monopolies and government bureaucracy.
tagline: A man with a dream that changed the nation.

title: Interstellar
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

title: Rock On!!
overview: Four friends reunite years after their rock band 'Magik' disbanded due to egos and tragedy, finding redemption through music and unbreakable brotherhood.
tagline: Live your dream.

title: Omkara
overview: A 2004 Kannada movie.
tagline: Experience the brilliance of Omkara.

title: Gorilla
overview: Madhukar, a merchant, travels to the jungle with his lovely daughter Rita. Unbeknownst to them they have entered the territory of cannibals who have a habit of sacrificing young women to the huge gorilla that has been terrorizing the land.
tagline: Experience the brilliance of Gorilla.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
tagline: Experience the brilliance of Street Fighter.

title: A Motown Christmas
overview: Smokey Robinson and Halle Bailey co-host NBC's "A Motown Christmas"
tagline: Experience the brilliance of A Motown Christmas.

title: She – Hero
overview: Romy is a brave little girl. She has a budgie called Mimi and Mimi got lost. Romy’s determination to find her budgie brings her out into the ancient woods, where she meets all sorts of everyday characters, each with their own story. She’ll not only make new friends along the way, but mainly she enjoys her adventure.
tagline: Experience the brilliance of She – Hero.

title: Welcome Back Gandhi
overview: After a 60-year absence, Gandhi returns to India to resume his Satyagraha Movement. While there, he must deal with the various social, economical and political issues that exist within the country.
tagline: Experience the brilliance of Welcome Back Gandhi.

title: Spirit Guardians: The Last Secret of the First Emperor
original_title: Spirit Guardians: The Last Secret of the First Emperor
overview: Set in the Dinh Dynasty of the 10th century, the period film follows seven loyal warriors who must race against time to transport 99 coffins to different parts of the kingdom as a decoy to the enemy and keep the final resting place of the first emperor a secret.
tagline: Experience the brilliance of Spirit Guardians: The Last Secret of the First Emperor.

title: Rangbaaz
overview: Shiv Prakash Shukla a 25 year age boy from Gorakhpur becomes the deadliest gangster of Uttar Pradesh in 1990s. He works for powerful politicians and involves in organised crimes. The state government felt danger from him and form STF to get him killed in a police encounter by tracking his mobile phone location.
tagline: Experience the brilliance of Rangbaaz.
creator: Bhav Dhulia

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: inception, the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

title: Fashion
overview: A small-town girl with big dreams rises to supermodel stardom in Mumbai's glamorous high-fashion industry, only to discover the steep emotional price of fame.
tagline: The price of success is higher than you think.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of allies Lt. Jim Gordon and DA Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets.
tagline: Why so serious?

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper.
tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean you have character.

title: Dune
overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family.
tagline: Beyond fear, destiny awaits.

title: The Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.
tagline: Welcome to the Real World.

title: Parasite
overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.
tagline: Act like you own the place.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos.
tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what is important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.
tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.

title: Arrival
overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.
tagline: Why are they here?
